actions.description: Call GenericInstrument.reset, which writes '*RST' (labinstruments/generic.py:65-68). The docstring says only 'Reset instrument' and does not state the effect on the RF output, the frequency or the power. An ordinary command: the safety reset does not call it, and it is not a re-enable or a safe-state action. A later read returns the instrument's reply and does not state what '*RST' set. The operator confirms the instrument, including whether the RF output is enabled.
actions.name: scpi_rst

facts.text: AgilentE8257D controls an E8257D PSG analog signal generator and is expected to work with the E8267D as well
The repository lists the Agilent E8257D/67D PSG analog signal generator among the supported instruments
get_frequency queries ":FREQ?" and divides the reply by the requested unit multiplier
get_power selects the unit with ":UNIT:POW <units>" and then queries ":POW?"
power_on writes ":OUTP ON" and power_off writes ":OUTP OFF"
get_output_state queries "OUTP:STAT?" and returns the reply as an integer
get_id sends "*IDN?" and replaces commas with spaces
GenericInstrument.reset sends "*RST" and its docstring says "Reset instrument"
GenericInstrument opens the default port 5025 and reads the identity while connecting
The accepted frequency units are GHz, MHz, kHz and Hz
The frequency setter defaults to GHz and the power setter to dBm
The README example sets 15 GHz, -20 dBm and turns the RF output on
The two setters pass the caller's frequency and power into their commands without a range check

measures.description: Identity reply to *IDN? with commas replaced by spaces
measures.name: identity

operator_required.name: frequency
operator_required.reason: the upstream set_frequency formats the caller's value into ':FREQ {value}{units}' (labinstruments/agilent.py:72) without stating a range; the operator supplies the frequency range of the installed generator

operator_required.name: power
operator_required.reason: the upstream set_power formats the caller's value into ':POW {value}{units}' (labinstruments/agilent.py:98) without stating a range; the operator supplies the power limit of the installed setup
